facts.fact: Morocco's Digital Development Agency launched the e-TAMKEEN e-learning programme on the Academia Raqmya platform in September 2024, after it trained over 6,800 civil servants at central and local levels between 2019 and 2023 on 23 digital topics.

systems.owner: Digital Development Agency; Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform

MAR.note: Data protection appears only as a training module; no law is stated.
Maroc Digital 2030 is named as the new national strategy, with no adoption or text status stated.
